sm_top.sm: A study indicates that Saudi missile plant expansion may enable the production of more powerful missiles.
Israeli military displaces Hebron families following an attack.
Houthi drone attacks targeted Dammam and the Shaybah oil field, resulting in multiple casualties including deaths and injuries.
Russian missiles and drones targeted Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine, causing casualties.
Ukraine targeted Russia with a large-scale drone attack, successfully striking an oil terminal in St. Petersburg.
The UN Security Council demanded clarification regarding drone attacks in Abyei.
A drone struck and sank a cargo vessel in the Black Sea near Romania, resulting in one fatality.
The Saudi-led coalition reports intercepting Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Saudi cities.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in multiple Palestinian deaths and injuries.
A Houthi siege and shelling in Taiz caused severe shortages and casualties, pushing hospitals toward collapse.
The death toll from the church attack in Jordan rises to nine.
Officials report Iran has detailed plans to strike Gulf undersea cables if war resumes.
Iran reported that oil tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Houthis claimed responsibility for seven attacks targeting Saudi airports and oil facilities.
Ballistic missile attacks struck Yemen's Aden.
An oil spill washed ashore in Umm Al Quwain following a tanker attack near the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian strikes targeted a Russian petrochemical plant while a blackout hit Crimea.
The Yemeni army stated that 620 Houthi fighters were neutralized over a 24-hour period.
Ukrainian drone attacks targeted Moscow airports and missile-parts plants, disrupting flights and prompting air defense interceptions.
Poland scrambled fighter jets in response to Russian strikes in western Ukraine.
The Houthis denied targeting the holy Islamic cities of Mecca and Medina.
Heavy airstrikes hit Yemen as Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi targets.
An oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that defense forces shot down or neutralized 140 of 176 enemy drones, with hits recorded at 19 locations.
U.S. officials state that Iranian preparations to attack Americans have reached advanced stages, while US warships in the Middle East prepare for potential strikes on Iran.
A Russian drone attack damaged a residential house in Kyiv and injured two people.
An investigation revealed that the RSF systematically targeted the healthcare system in El Fasher.
The death toll rises in Lozova following a Russian strike on a market.
Drones struck industrial infrastructure in Omsk, Russia, sparking a massive fire.
Following successive Houthi strikes on major Saudi targets, the Saudi-led coalition retaliates with airstrikes.
UN reports at least 306 people killed by drones in Sudan.
A Russian attack on the Chernihiv region killed one civilian and wounded several others.
A Houthi attack on a Saudi airport resulted in two deaths and several injuries.
Russian MoD claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed hundreds of Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Sudan denied responsibility for a drone strike on Amiet Market in Abyei that reportedly killed 220 people.
Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast killed three people, set a high-rise on fire, and damaged a shop.
Russian Ministry of Defence claims strikes on Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure, drone storage and launch sites, and temporary deployment areas across 147 districts.
Russian forces seized control of multiple settlements in Ukraine over the past week.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 8 people and injured 67 over the past day.
Red Cross reports drone attacks in Sudan are killing hundreds, targeting homes, markets, and displacement camps.
